Use cases

Forecasting products for teams exposed to volatility.

Qronon replaces the single retrospective disaster story with a multi-sector pilot hub focused on measurable operating pain and success metrics.

Pilot design

Each use case starts with a measurable forecasting task.

Insurance and reinsurance

Pain point: Weeks 2-6 event risk and portfolio exposure are difficult to monitor with confidence.

Qronon angle: Probabilistic extreme-event outlooks and scenario inputs for risk teams.

Pilot metric: Improved RPSS/CRPS, earlier event signal and better portfolio monitoring.

Energy and grids

Pain point: Demand, renewable generation and grid stress are increasingly weather-driven.

Qronon angle: Medium-range probabilistic weather signals for demand and supply planning.

Pilot metric: Improved event hit rate and better imbalance or stress-risk forecasts.

Aviation and logistics

Pain point: Storms, fog, wind and temperature extremes disrupt routes, assets and schedules.

Qronon angle: Earlier regional disruption signals for route and asset planning.

Pilot metric: More lead time and clearer planning thresholds for operational decisions.

Public-sector resilience

Pain point: Emergency planning needs reliable early signals before short-term alerts arrive.

Qronon angle: Scenario-based early warning for floods, storms, heat and cascading risks.

Pilot metric: Earlier risk flagging, calibrated uncertainty and practical decision thresholds.

Climate-risk analytics

Pain point: Risk platforms need weather-conditioned inputs that update faster than climate models.

Qronon angle: Forecast engine and API outputs feeding analytics, dashboards and risk models.

Pilot metric: Better downstream risk-score performance and clearer event conditioning.
